items.title: A maximal modification makes all local rings rational, and normalized blowups preserve this
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if reduction to rational singularities is possible for a two dimensional local normal Nagata domain, then there is a finite sequence of normalized blowups in closed points whose last term has every closed point defining a rational singularity, and which is in particular a normal projective modification (statement lines 2086-2098). The proof (proof lines 2100-2136) chooses a modification maximizing the length of the first cohomology, spreads modifications of the local rings at closed points to the ambient scheme to prove rationality there by maximality, and dominates the maximal modification by normalized blowups, propagating rationality along the local extensions. H3: a maximality argument with a spreading step, written out in full.
